steps.title: Set the inserts and mount the ESC
steps.goal: ESC held by 4 screws in brass inserts on the fuselage floor.
tools: Soldering iron with an M3 insert tip

safety.text: Insert tip at 220 °C. Park the iron in its stand between inserts.

actions.do: Press 4 M3 heat-set inserts into the floor bosses with the iron at `220 °C`. Stop when the insert top is flush.
Let the bosses cool for `2 min`. An M3 screw turned into each insert must stand upright.
Place FUS-003 on the bosses, wires toward the rear.
Fit 4x M3x10 SHCS with nylon washers, one drop of threadlocker on each thread. Tighten snug in a cross pattern.

check.text: Push the ESC firmly with a finger.
check.target: no movement; 4 of 4 screw heads seated on their washers

can_go_wrong.problem: Insert goes in crooked or too deep
can_go_wrong.fix: Reheat it, pull it out on the iron tip, replace the boss. Do not shim.

can_go_wrong.problem: Threadlocker on the boss cracks the plastic
can_go_wrong.fix: One drop on the screw thread only, never on the boss.

steps.title: Connect the leads, then strap in the battery
steps.goal: Every lead plugged and supported; battery strapped and connected last.

safety.text: Props off. The XT60 is the last connection you make and the first you break.
Inspect the pack before it goes in: no swelling, dents or cut insulation.

actions.do: Plug the left and right motor leads (MR30) at the wing root. Clip each lead to the fuselage side wall.
Plug the aileron servo lead (JR 3-pin). Tape it where it leaves the servo.
Multimeter on continuity across the ESC's XT60 pins: it must NOT beep (no short).
Lay FUS-002 on the anti-slip pad and close the strap through both floor slots.
Plug the XT60 last. The ESC beeps its start-up tune.

check.text: Weigh the complete aircraft, ready to fly, on the kitchen scale.
Transmitter on, props off: run the motor test and move the aileron stick.
check.target: both motors spin, correct direction; aileron moves both ways

can_go_wrong.problem: A lead is trapped under the battery strap
can_go_wrong.fix: Unplug the XT60 first, reroute the lead along the side wall, re-strap.

can_go_wrong.problem: A motor spins the wrong way
can_go_wrong.fix: Reverse it in the ESC configurator. Do not cut or re-solder the phase wires.
Weigh each subassembly against parts.csv; report the part in CHANGE-REQUESTS.md, do not file foam off.
